subject: U7: update workspaces-daemon.test.js for grouped /workspaces shape
description: In the ws-registry feature (repo worktree under .claude/orchestrator/worktrees/.../feature-ws-registry), U3 changed GET /workspaces default response from the flat [{path,name,current}] array to a GROUPED shape: { ok, current, workspaces:[{ name, repos:[{path,name,current}], current }] }. A ?flat=1 query param still returns the OLD flat [{path,name,current}] shape for compatibility. test/workspaces-daemon.test.js still asserts the flat shape on the default endpoint (cases B/C/G/H read w.path / w.name / w.current on top-level list entries) so 13 assertions now fail by design. Update those assertions to the grouped shape: find a workspace by iterating workspaces[].repos[] for the repo path, assert repo.current and group.current, and group.name===basename. Keep at least one case exercising ?flat=1 to lock the compat shape. Do NOT change routes/meta.js (it is correct per spec). Verify both test/workspaces-daemon.test.js and test/per-repo-workspace-scoping.test.js pass.
